units.source_text: 是因为在御旅所前面遇见了苗子，心灵上受到的冲击远比苗子强烈得多。

en.t: It was because she had met Naeko in front of the otabisho; the shock to her heart was far stronger than Naeko's.

units.source_text: 按苗子说，她早就知道自己是双胞胎，所以一直在寻找孪生姐妹。

en.t: According to Naeko, she had long known that she was a twin, and so she had always been searching for her twin sister.

units.source_text: 但是，千重子做梦也没有想到自己是孪生的。

en.t: But Chieko had never dreamed that she herself was a twin.

units.source_text: 事情来得太唐突，没能像苗子发现自己那样感到欢天喜地。

en.t: It had happened too suddenly for her to feel the same overwhelming joy that Naeko had felt on finding her.
